item.headline: What to Know About the Planned Explosion in Middletown, Iowa
item.summary: The Army plans to blow up a stockpile of dangerously degrading explosives at a facility in southeastern Iowa on Wednesday morning, Army officials said Tuesday.
item.author: Quinn Glabicki

reads.result: Army officials said on Tuesday that they plan to blow up a stockpile of dangerously degrading explosives at a facility in Middletown, in southeastern Iowa, on Wednesday morning.
